title: Agent injects pending steering
description:
As a procedure operator, I want pending steering messages added to an active agent before its next LLM call, so that long-running procedures can respond to newly supplied guidance without restarting.

Feature: Mid-run procedure steering

Scenario: Pending steering is injected once before an agent turn
Given a running Tactus agent has a chat recorder with steering messages after its stored watermark
When the agent prepares its next LLM turn
Then the steering messages are appended to agent history as a system message
And the agent stores a new watermark so the same steering is not injected again.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Story complete: pending steering is injected once before agent turns and watermarking prevents duplicate injection.
